server_info.name: mcp-intake-golden
server_info.title: Purpose-built fixture for MCP tools/list intake coverage.

tools.name: widgets_list
tools.description: List widgets. Trailing-verb name shape, and an explicit read-only hint.

tools.name: get_widget
tools.description: Read a single widget. Leading read verb with no annotation, so the name heuristic classifies it.

tools.name: acme_create_widget
tools.description: Create a widget. The verb sits mid-name behind a service qualifier, which must not become the resource.

tools.name: update_widget
tools.description: Update a widget. Update verbs map to a semantic PATCH.

tools.name: delete_widget
tools.description: Delete a widget. Destructive hint plus a delete verb.

tools.name: send_digest
tools.description: A write-shaped verb the server declares read-only; the annotation must win over the name.
